chapter_title: Chương 249: 0251【Xác nhận lên bản tin thời sự VTV】

segments.title: Chương 249: 0251【Xác nhận lên bản tin thời sự VTV】
segments.content:
A total of three leaders gave speeches. The shortest was five or six minutes, while the longest went on for over ten minutes.

The reporters served them with an array of cameras.

Finally, Chen Guiliang went on stage to thank the leaders, guests, reporters, contestants, and audience members present. He stated that the leaders had spoken very comprehensively and that he would do his best to organize the tournament well every year. The contestants were all outstanding, the audience was very enthusiastic, and he wished everyone happy gaming every day in the future.

The competition began right after.

The 16 teams had already drawn lots online.

The round of 16 to 8 was a double-elimination tournament, requiring a total of 16 matches to be played over one day.

16 matches in one day might seem like a lot, but this was *Three Kingdoms Kill*, and it was 1v1. If one side got lucky, a match could end very quickly.

The two hosts from Gamefy were still Zhang Hongsheng and Huang Xi.

Huang Xi had just joined last year and was practically a nobody, but this year she had already gained some fame and was regarded as a goddess by many gamers.

"Alright, the two teams coming on stage now are the Zhejiang University representative team and the Hong Kong University representative team. Their respective contestants are..." Zhang Hongsheng began to introduce the teams and their members.

Following that, Huang Xi explained the tournament format: "This year's competition is slightly different from last year's. The double-elimination round of 16 will only feature 1v1 matches, while the 3v3 mode will be added in the quarter-final knockout stage. During the 1v1 mode, the same contestant can play multiple rounds. As long as they don't lose, they can even achieve a 1-on-3 sweep, letting their two teammates rest for the entire match!"

Zhang Hongsheng said, "The Zhejiang University representative team is sending out contestant Kong Zhibin. Hong Kong University is sending out a female contestant named Wang Lingfei. She is also one of only two female contestants among the sixteen representative teams..."

Huang Xi said, "The two sides are drawing their identity cards. Wang Lingfei drew the Monarch. Both sides will blindly pick five general cards. This year's 1v1 matches, in addition to the standard pack generals, also include the Wind and Fire packs..."

"Contestant Wang Lingfei has drawn Guo Jia, Ma Chao, Sun Shangxiang, Sima Yi, and Zhang Fei."

"Contestant Kong Zhibin has drawn Zhao Yun, Lu Bu, Zhuge Liang, Xu Chu, and Xiahou Dun."

"Contestant Kong Zhibin bans Sun Shangxiang."

"Contestant Wang Lingfei bans Lu Bu. She chose Ma Chao. Isn't she picking Guo Jia?"

"Contestant Kong Zhibin, playing second, chose Zhao Yun. Huh, why didn't he pick Zhuge Liang? I have a feeling this game is going to take a long time."

To avoid being disturbed by the hosts and the audience, both contestants wore noise-canceling headphones.

A Ma Chao versus a Zhao Yun could be a battle to the bitter end.

To accommodate the leaders, guests, and reporters, the two hosts also explained the rules of Three Kingdoms Kill and displayed the skill descriptions for the two generals on the big screen.

Even the reporters who had never played *Three Kingdoms Kill* before quickly understood the basic rules.

Chi Yufeng watched with great interest; he seemed very drawn to this kind of game.

Shi Yuzhu, on the other hand, was thinking about when he could hold a *ZT Online* tournament. But how would the competition work? It couldn't just be about who topped up more, with victory decided by who could hack people down with better equipment, right?

Ma Chao discards a card, attacks, judgment is black. Zhao Yun's attack becomes a dodge. Pass.

Zhao Yun plays Something for Nothing, then another Something for Nothing, and attacks. Ma Chao dodges. Zhao Yun discards a +1 horse. Pass.

After six rounds, neither had lost a drop of health.

Ma Chao was especially unlucky; all his skill judgments came up black.

What a boring match.

Finally, in the seventh round, the female contestant's luck turned. Her skill judgment was red, forcing one point of damage on Zhao Yun.

After more than ten rounds, Zhao Yun fell into a disadvantage. The number of times he drew a Peach was no match for the number of times his opponent's skill judgment was red.

In the 23rd round, Ma Chao wore Zhao Yun down to his death.

Fortunately, this was a speed tournament. During a player's turn, excluding Zhen Ji's card draws, there was only a 30-second time limit.

Even if all 23 rounds used up the full time, it would only take 11 minutes.

Most of the time, for vanilla generals like Ma Chao and Zhao Yun, a turn was over in a few seconds. The 23 rounds were completed in just 4 minutes, averaging less than 11 seconds per round.

Intentionally dragging out the time was very poor sportsmanship and would definitely get you flamed by netizens.

The female contestant from Hong Kong University continued to play, already fantasizing about a 1-on-3 sweep.

The reality, however, was a reverse 1-on-3 sweep...

The second contestant from the Zhejiang University team, among the five general cards he drew, had both Zhou Yu and Lu Xun.

The female contestant from Hong Kong University also had a good draw, with both Huang Yueying and Zhen Ji.

After the ban phase, it was Zhou Yu versus Zhen Ji.

This time, it only took twelve rounds. Zhou Yu used Sabotage to kill Zhen Ji outright!

The third game was even more amazing. The Zhejiang University contestant played Yu Ji.

When he picked Yu Ji, the entire audience cheered.

Chi Yufeng asked, "Is this Yu Ji very powerful?"

Chen Guiliang explained, "He's very unpredictable, which makes him very entertaining to watch. This general is very dirty, it's all about psychological warfare."

Yu Ji started by using Deception to play a Sleight of Hand. Diao Chan thought for a moment and chose to question it.

Smack, she lost health.

He used Deception again to attack. Diao Chan chose to believe it, but her opponent played a dodge.

The contestant from Hong Kong University guessed wrong every time.

After a few rounds, Diao Chan was on the verge of a mental breakdown. Luckily, her general was powerful enough to hold on.

But after losing two health from questioning a Something for Nothing and a Daze, the one-health Diao Chan fell into a complete disadvantage...

As noon approached, a team that had been eliminated online but was invited due to their high ranking played an eight-player exhibition match.

Their chaotic and wild plays were a source of great amusement for the audience.

Next, the Three Kingdoms Kill cosplay, a recurring segment, made its appearance. The generals from the Wei kingdom appeared this morning, and Xu Fengyin's Zhen Ji also made a showing. The Shu kingdom would have to wait until the afternoon.

The whole audience shouted various character lines along with them, the atmosphere fervent and somewhat geeky.

The leaders and VIPs were busy and left after watching the first match. But many reporters stayed, finding the spectacle of the entire audience chanting lines in unison novel and astonishing.

The reporters watched the beautiful female cosplayers while whispering among themselves:

"This game is just so-so, right? Why is the audience acting like they've gone mad?"

"That eight-player exhibition match just now was pretty interesting. The 1v1 is just too boring."

"I think the 1v1 is fine, and I'm really looking forward to the 3v3 mode being added in the knockout stage."

"Three Kingdoms Kill has a lot of loyal fans. I heard that sales of the physical card game have already surpassed 1 million sets. And that's not even counting the many pirated sets."

"A million sets? A standalone game would be ecstatic to sell a tenth of that."

After the Wei kingdom generals' cosplay was over, Chen Guiliang walked on stage: "This concludes this morning's events. On the day of the finals, we have also invited two stars, Lin Junjie and Jin Sha, to perform the 'Three Kingdoms Kill' theme song..."

Many of the reporters who had planned to leave today suddenly changed their minds.

They would just treat it as a publicly-funded trip to see celebrities. Anyway, with celebrities as an excuse, their newspapers and magazines couldn't say much.

Why was Jin Sha invited?

It was an additional condition proposed by Lin Junjie's side when he was signed for the endorsement: for any large-scale event, Jin Sha had to be included. Jin Sha's appearance fee would be paid separately.

The agency's absurd demands had tied Lin Junjie and Jin Sha together for the past two years.

Once or twice was fine, but doing it every time was annoying.

During one offline event to rally votes for the music charts, a fan of Lin Junjie even rushed up to Jin Sha and yelled, "Without JJ, you're nothing!"

Chen Guiliang didn't mind this. He also took the opportunity to make a request: Lin Junjie and Jin Sha must register for Hainai.com accounts.

On the day of the finals, entertainment reporters showed up uninvited.

It was also possible that Lin Junjie's and Jin Sha's agencies had invited them.

Jin Sha performed "Chant of the Dragon Rider" before the competition, and Lin Junjie performed "Cao Cao" after it ended.

Chen Guiliang simply invited them to present the awards to the winners together.

This year's champion, runner-up, and third place were: Peking University, Zhejiang University, and Fudan University.

The subsequent rankings were: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Sichuan University, Xi'an Jiao Tong University, Tsinghua University, Wuhan University, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Taiwan University, Xidian University, Hong Kong University...

Among the representative teams from Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, the highest rank achieved was only tenth place.

Of course, everyone who came received a prize: a collector's edition set of *Three Kingdoms Kill* physical cards for each person.

Host Huang Xi even joked with the two stars, "Do you two usually play Three Kingdoms Kill?"

Lin Junjie said, "I do. *Three Kingdoms Kill* is also operated in Singapore. When I'm at home with no work, I'll play a few games on the Singapore server. If you don't believe me, you can test me with any question about Three Kingdoms Kill."

"Really?"

Huang Xi asked, "What are Sun Shangxiang's skills?"

Lin Junjie said, "Marriage and Virtuous Heroine."

Huang Xi laughed, "Haha, you really are a loyal Three Kingdoms Kill player. You even know that the common term for Matrimony is Marriage."

Lin Junjie gave an awkward smile; he had actually misremembered.

But after endorsing *Three Kingdoms Kill*, he had indeed gotten curious and logged into the Singapore server to register an account. He got hooked after playing two games and would log on from time to time.

Huang Xi then asked Jin Sha, "Do you play Three Kingdoms Kill?"

Jin Sha answered, "I play it occasionally."

She had actually never played it... it wasn't her own endorsement, after all.

Zhang Hongsheng quickly changed the subject, shouting to the audience, "JJ has agreed to have an eight-player live game with CEO Chen and some lucky members of the audience. Let's have CEO Chen draw the lucky numbers!"

There was a computer in the work area, and a camera was pointed at its screen, which was displayed in real-time on the jumbotron.

Chen Guiliang pressed the mouse to start the draw, then quickly hit the spacebar to stop it.

Zhang Hongsheng announced, "The seat numbers of these six lucky audience members are: B205, A102..."

"I won, I won!"

"Holy crap, that's my number!"

Cries of surprise came from the audience, and those around looked at the six lucky winners with envy.

For various reasons, some of the audience members at the venue hadn't stayed to watch the finals.

And many of the audience members today were fans of Lin Junjie. They didn't even play Three Kingdoms Kill; they only bought tickets to chase after their star!

Of course, seeing their idol like *Three Kingdoms Kill*, they also decided to give it a try when they got home.

Ever since Lin Junjie became the spokesperson, quite a few players had gotten into the game because of him.

Chen Guiliang, Lin Junjie, and the six lucky audience members sat together and began a joyous live game.

One audience member was the Monarch, while both Chen Guiliang and Lin Junjie were Rebels.

However, the Monarch winked at everyone and asked, "Do you all remember the first time CEO Chen went online publicly?"

"Understood," said the Spy in the third seat.

The audience member in the second seat asked, "What's going on?"

The Rebel in the fourth seat said, "Focus fire on CEO Chen, but don't let him die."

"Hahaha!" Everyone burst into laughter.

Chen Guiliang was speechless. "You guys are pulling this stunt in a live game too?"

The torture of CEO Chen began again, and even Lin Junjie joined in. The venue was instantly filled with laughter.

After being tormented for half an hour, Lin Junjie said he had to catch a flight, and the others finally worked together to kill the Monarch.

That evening, Chen Guiliang received a call from Director Kou: "Next Monday, watch *Xinwen Lianbo*."

"Thank you so much, Director!" Chen Guiliang said with heartfelt gratitude.

Regarding whether to report a brief news item on *Xinwen Lianbo*, even CCTV couldn't make the decision on its own; it had to seek opinions from higher-ups. This was because the SARFT had issued a ban, prohibiting game shows from being broadcast on satellite channels.

Although there was no ban on game-related news, CCTV didn't want to stir up trouble; it was better to be safe than sorry.

Director Kou must have been the one pushing for this behind the scenes.

The GAPP and the SARFT were on the same administrative level, so Director Kou also had to call in some favors.

(End of Chapter)
